[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT10 ]Man, that's grim. I don't wanna go like this. Not even[XENO:n ]
killed by Mechon, just some monsters in a cave.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT10 ]They probably had families...children...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT12 ]Maybe. It wouldn't surprise me.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]But why do you say that?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

Reyn, shouldn't we return[XENO:n ]
them to the Giant God?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

What's born from the Giant God is returned to the Giant God.[XENO:n ]
